Situation Report – Day 27

  • Ceasefire / Diplomacy
    • Trump announced a SECOND pause on strikes for 10 days (deadline 6 Apr 2026, 20:00 ET), citing an "Iranian Government request" and saying talks are "going very well."
    • Iran denies direct talks. Pakistan is mediating. First pause (5 days) was violated by US/Israeli strikes on Isfahan and Khorramshahr → trust in pauses low.
  • Airspace & Movements
    • Regional airspace closures: airports closed in Iran, Israel, Iraq, Syria, Lebanon, Jordan. Flight-scan snapshot: 352 commercial aircraft; 0 military in scan.
    • Ongoing airstrike exchanges continue as part of US-Israel campaign vs Iran and Iranian/Hezbollah/Hamas counterstrikes on Israel (operational tempo remains high).
  • Khamenei funeral / High-risk timeline
    • Funeral underway; world leaders attending. Iranian generals publicly warn of a "harsh response" to attacks during the event.
    • Funeral period increases risk of rapid, symbolic retaliation and restricted windows for kinetic actions.
  • Northern front & Lebanon
    • Daily Hezbollah activity continues along northern border (sustained low-to-medium exchanges).
    • Reports of growing Lebanese public frustration with Hezbollah — potential political pressure on Hezbollah posture.
  • Operations & Security
    • IDF & Shin Bet reported killing a Hamas leader who held four hostages, including Capt. Daniel Perez (operational intelligence success).
    • IDF arrested eight Palestinians in West Bank raids. Senior IDF leadership reaffirms changed tactics since Oct. 7.
  • Cyber & EW
    • EU lawmaker investigation finds evidence of hacking by Israeli-linked spyware — political and legal fallout risk.
    • Russian firms tout new anti-drone rounds and mobile UAV jammers. EW capabilities in region are rising; drone survivability decreasing.
  • International tech / posture
    • Russia promoting advanced counter-UAV systems. Expect more EW and anti-drone measures near hotspots.
  • 🟢 Good News
    • Reports that U.S. intervention prevented Israeli strikes on top Iranian negotiators — those negotiators reportedly spared.
    • IDF/Shin Bet action removed an operational threat who held hostages.
  • Threat assessment: escalating.

  • הערכת איום: הסלמה.
